correctness.rationale: Direct Beta moments give the exact variance; the independently reconstructed derivative identity and all-g sign proof show a positive/simple quintic root iff p<(g+5)/(12g), with the claimed derivative signs. Critical c1/c2 sign conditions at g=2 and g>=3 are proved explicitly; the exact checker confirms symbolic formulas, a 48-case complete binary-state enumeration and endpoint limits. The code is supplementary, not an infinite proof.
